title: Good for cramped bathrooms
text: Good for cramped bathrooms. I bought this when we moved into an apartment with the world's smallest bathroom. This definitely helped save space and allowed for my husband and I to have all of our products easily dispensable. However I do want to mention that it isn't the nicest looking product, and it feels a tad on the cheap side, but it works great is you are looking to save space.
